questions.question: What does this return?
options: Every column, for users in London
questions.explanation: SELECT * means all columns; WHERE keeps only matching rows.

questions.question: Why use `?` placeholders instead of f-strings when putting values into SQL?
options: f-strings are not allowed in Python
questions.explanation: Placeholders keep user input as data, never as SQL code, which blocks one of the most common attacks on the web.
